def attempt(f):
    try:
        result=f()
        return ['ok', list(result) if isinstance(result, bytes) else list(map(ord,result))]
    except UnicodeError as e:
        return ['error',type(e).__name__,list(e.object) if isinstance(e.object,bytes) else list(map(ord,e.object)),e.start,e.end,e.reason]
def state(obj):
    s=obj.getstate()
    return [list(s[0]),str(s[1])] if isinstance(s,tuple) else str(s)
def run(kind, chunks, policy):
    obj=(codecs.getincrementalencoder if kind=='encode' else codecs.getincrementaldecoder)('iso2022_kr')(policy)
    out=[state(obj)]
    for chunk, final in chunks:
        value=''.join(map(chr,chunk)) if kind=='encode' else bytes(chunk)
        out.append(attempt(lambda: obj.encode(value,final) if kind=='encode' else obj.decode(value,final)))
        out.append(state(obj))
    obj.reset();out.append(state(obj))
    return out
